{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the trial data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for missing values in patient_id
missing_patient_id = df['patient_id'].isnull().sum()

# Check for duplicate patient_id values
duplicate_patient_id = df['patient_id'].duplicated().sum()

# Count total number of unique patient_id entries
num_patients = df['patient_id'].nunique()

# Print results
missing_patient_id, duplicate_patient_id, num_patients"}
